sources.note: Main Veradigm EHR product page. Describes core features: one-click templates, Smart Lists, HCC alerts, telehealth, Ambient Scribe AI, PDMP integration, care plans.
ONC regulatory compliance page listing five certified products: Practice Fusion EHR, Veradigm EHR 26, Veradigm ePrescribe, FollowMyHealth, and Veradigm View.
Corporate overview. Claims 180,000+ physician users, 2,700 hospitals, 13,000 extended care organizations.
ePrescribe product page. Details EPCS, PDMP, RxTruePrice, eAUTH electronic prior authorization. Also available standalone at $59/month.
DORN diagnostic ordering and results network. Cloud-based hub connecting to 500+ lab and radiology centers via single API.
Practice Management product page. Separate product from EHR. Covers scheduling, claims (98% first-pass rate), RCM, coding error detection.
Specialty PM variant. Lists 30+ supported specialties with specialty-specific templates and protocols.
FollowMyHealth patient portal. EHR-agnostic, mobile-first. Secure messaging, scheduling, bill pay, remote monitoring, 240+ languages.
EHR solutions overview page. Describes the broader EHR ecosystem including clinical, prescribing, and integration capabilities.
EHR in Practice profile. Details product history (formerly Allscripts Professional EHR), deployment options (cloud/on-prem), specialty support, Black Book #1 rankings.
Vendor profile. Covers Allscripts-to-Veradigm transition, product portfolio, and market positioning.
Capterra reviews: 3.5/5 (66 reviews). Users praise customizability and templates but complain about slow performance and steep learning curve.
Healthcare Dive article on Allscripts renaming to Veradigm in January 2023 after selling hospital/large practice segment.
Altera Digital Health announcement of completing $700M acquisition of Allscripts hospital business (Sunrise, Paragon, TouchWorks, dbMotion) in May 2022.
Veradigm Nasdaq delisting notice (February 2024) after failing to file annual/quarterly reports due to revenue restatement investigation.
2025 financial update. Revenue ~$583-588M for 2024. ~2,450 employees. Plans to relist after completing restatements in 2026.
Veradigm acquired Koha Health (RCM company focused on musculoskeletal/orthopedic practices) in January 2024.
Coverage of Nasdaq delisting and $140M ScienceIO acquisition (AI platform for healthcare data structuring).
Developer portal. Open APIs including Unity and FHIR for third-party integrations. App Expo marketplace for certified applications.
Market share data. Veradigm at ~3.6% of U.S. ambulatory EHR market as of January 2025.
